From: Samira Khan <samira@seedbank.ai>

Cc: dev-team@seedbank.ai
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:44:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in Redwood — quick demo?

Hi Maya,

We signed up for a trial this morning and I wanted to see if we could get a short walkthrough of Redwood Inference for our team. Quick context: we’re a mid-stage startup (SeedBank.ai) building a document-to-action assistant for financial advisers. We ingest ~400k documents/month currently, expect to hit 1M+ in 6 months. Typical prompt lengths are 250-1,000 tokens; peak concurrent requests estimate ~30-50 QPS during trading-hours.

Main asks:
- Demo of latency/cost tradeoffs and autoscaling in a short session (30 mins)
- How Redwood handles prefix caching for repeated prompt patterns
- Any enterprise privacy/compliance notes for market data

Happy to share a small traffic sample (attached). Prefer morning PST next week. Who from your side should join?

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Product, SeedBank.ai

Hi Samira  


Thanks for signing up and for the context — I can get you on the calendar. Maya is our solutions engineer and will lead the technical fit check. Before we lock a slot, two quick clarifying items to make the call focused:

1) Is the 400k documents/month figure for indexing or active Q&A traffic?
2) For the 30-50 QPS peak, is that sustained for >10 minutes or short bursts around market events?

If you reply with those two points I can pass to Maya and she'll propose 2-3 short windows. Also which timezone are you primarily in (I saw PST but wanted to confirm)?

Cheers,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference

Hi Samira  


Great to meet you virtually. Thanks for the sample CSV  that helps. I asked Ben to include me so we can keep this a tight technical session. A few focused questions so we make the 30-minute slot count:

- Use case: is the assistant answering free-form questions from advisers or generating structured outputs (e.g., trade recommendations, summary bullets)?
- Volume: are the 400k docs used to build embeddings + retrieval, and are the QPS estimates coming from end-user agents hitting the API?
- Latency SLO: do you need sub-200ms P95 for certain interactive flows, or is 300-500ms acceptable?
- Auth/compliance: any IP allowlist, VPC, or data residency constraints we should prep for?

Proposed 30-minute windows (PST):
- Wed 2026-11-04 09:00-09:30
- Wed 2026-11-04 11:30-12:00
- Thu 2026-11-05 08:30-09:00

If none work I can open more options. Also, if you want our pre-demo checklist (short) I can drop it here — includes sample telemetry we like to see and a quick model/config ask.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Maya / Ben,

Thanks  answers below:
- Use case: mixed  primarily structured summaries and action recommendations (so both retrieval + structured generation). We do some free-form Q&A but the majority is templated output.
- Volume: 400k is docs ingested for retrieval/embeddings. QPS numbers are for the inference API hitting our assistant during market hours; likely 30-50 sustained for ~20-30 minutes with spikes to ~90 for <2 minutes during open/close.
- Latency SLO: aiming for P95 < 350ms for interactive flows, batch jobs can be looser.
- Auth/compliance: we need SOC2 and standard contract clauses; no special residency right now.

I attached an expanded traffic sample and a small spreadsheet with token distribution (seedbank-poc-notes.xlsx). Morning PST on Wed 11/4 works great. Prefer the 09:00 slot.

Attendees from our side: me, our lead infra engineer (dev-team@seedbank.ai), and the product manager.

Cheers,
Samira
